_comment: Three 4x4 tasks (standard, Latin, diagonal; data/grid_tasks4.npz), recurrent linear attention. Condition 1: task embedding added to the input (puzzle_emb, one row per task). hidden 32, 2 heads (16 per head = number of cells), FFN inner 64, 4 blocks x 2 segments, no augmentation (diagonal constraints break under row/column swaps). ema_puzzle_emb: the EMA also averages the task-embedding table (without it the evaluated EMA body reads the current raw embedding and collapses; found 2026-10-18). HALF (2026-10-18): hidden 16 (2 heads of 8), FFN inner 32, task embedding 16. PREFIX (URM/HRM style): the task embedding is one extra position in front of the 16 cells (RoPE angle 0), not added to the cells.
